venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 7/4 (AM: Maggie & Chef Josh; PM: Carey & Chef Lucas).** Total net sales $14,537.80 vs an $8,422 target (+73%), 283 guests (Tock) at a $51.37 check average; comps $304.39 / 2.09%. Splits: DC/AM $1,246.27, D&C PM $13,291.53, Garden/6A $3,064.66; food $2,672.65; no events. Solid morning pop with Care Leite before a lull and the cocktail rush — Reggie came in on his day off to help close the bar. D&C was super slow until a great pop around 11pm that stayed busy the last 1.5 hours. Chill, fireworks-filled Saturday in the Garden; slow but good-vibes night for the kitchen and a great first day for Dante. Favorite moment: the end-of-night team kicking into gear for the late pop and keeping a full house happy to last call — in-house guests handed out July 4th candy to staff. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 7/4 (AM: Sam/Justin/Shannon; PM: Braden/Marcus).** Total net sales $11,143 vs a $16,500 target (−32%); food $3,628; comps $498. Splits: Municipal Bar morning $1,833 (76 guests) / evening $7,473, Sun Club $2,508, Hot Eye $1,154. (Guest count omitted from dashboard — the evening OpenTable field was entered as 0 despite a busy service, so total covers can't be reliably summed.) Slower-than-normal Fourth of July morning — well staffed, cut aggressively, helped by 3 food tours. Evening never turned fully but larger parties carried sales, with a good pop right after the ~10:15pm fireworks. Highlight was the Sun Club Anniversary Party: live grill station slinging dogs and burgers, a live acoustic set from Claire Vandider, and poolside vibes rolling into the evening. A walk-up bought the last room, putting the hotel at 100% occupancy. No incidents; no 86s.
